import java.io.ObjectInputStream;
import java.io.ObjectOutputStream;
import java.util.List;
import static java.util.Collections.emptyList;

class UnusedBindingsConventions {
    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    @Deprecated private int injected;
    private int retained = 2;

    private void readObject(ObjectInputStream input) {}
    private void writeObject(ObjectOutputStream output) {}
    @Deprecated private void lifecycle() {}

    private int referenced() { return retained; }

    List<String> run(int unusedParameter) {
        referenced();
        for (String _item : emptyList()) {
            referenced();
        }
        return emptyList();
    }
}

@Deprecated
class FrameworkManaged {
    private int injected;
}
